name: Camera_Educational_Showcase
description: The camera highlights educational points of interest during flythrough. Geology labels, rock-type callouts, weather indicators, POI markers.

questions.question: Can the player identify rock types from visual labels overlaid during flythrough?
Does the camera pause or slow at educational POIs for reading time?
Do educational callouts use real geological terminology the player can learn?
Is the educational content discoverable without breaking the cinematic flow?
Do the educational overlays look premium (not like debug text) for screenshots?
Can a clip showing 'learning while flying' become a unique selling point in marketing?
Are the educational POIs placed at locations that feel naturally interesting?
Does the cloud education (stratus, cumulus types) match actual cloud formations in the sky?
Do weather indicators (wind direction, pressure) appear contextually?
Are educational triggers in the Level Sequence as Camera Shots or events?
Can educational text be localized without modifying the Sequencer?
Does the showcase clear all UI elements cleanly at the end of flythrough?
Does the graph store educational content as separate data from camera positions?
Does UE5.8's Text Render or Widget system handle cinematic overlays without tearing?
Do educational overlays add zero frame-time cost (pre-rendered or cached)?
Is educational text large enough to read at 1080p from couch distance?
Does a narrator or subtle voiceover accompany the educational callouts?
Does educational-showcase-first differentiate this game from pure entertainment titles?
What cinematic polish is reduced to make room for educational content?
What evidence exists that educational features drive wishlists or press coverage?
Does this chain reach a human who learns something about the real world?
Does this depend on the environment_education module being wired to Sequencer events?
Does this depend on a localization system for educational text?
Does this prove that educational mechanics can exist without a separate UI layer?
Were the POI locations derived from real planetary geology surveys?
What geological reference data is needed to write accurate educational callouts?
